message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. A central caricature depicts a light-skinned man with short dark hair and a receding hairline. He wears a tan, short-sleeved collared shirt with epaulets and brown trousers secured by a white belt. Seated on a large grey motorcycle, he looks back over his right shoulder. His right hand grips a handlebar; his left foot, in a dark boot, rests on a grey platform. The motorcycle features a large rear tire, a dual exhaust pipe, and a black license plate. 

The motorcycle and man are positioned in front of a large flat-screen monitor displaying a grey winding road under a cloudy sky. Two signs on this road read "KPK" in red and black letters. A grey pole supports the monitor.

The background is a textured lavender-grey. Text at the top reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS" and "JARINGAN RAJA TAMBANG BATU BARA" in yellow. The large white masthead says "TEMPO". Below it, text reads "EDISI 6-12 AGUSTUS 2012". On the left, large white text reads "SIMSALABIM JENDERAL SIM". The Bottom-left corner displays pricing, a website, and a barcode. Bottom-right text identifies "Inspektur Jenderal Djoko Susilo".
